title: Irrelevant error message when inheriting from inner class
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7 stable, 4.8dev4

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 5 5500 (12 threads) - 15.87 ГиБ memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Inheriting from an inner class (e.g., `extends GlobalClass.InnerClass`) triggers an error in the Output panel:
`ERROR: Resource file not found: res:// (expected type: Script)`
The inheritance itself works as expected, this feature also is [documented](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/gdscript_basics.html#:~:text=An%20inner%20class%20inside%20another%20class%20file) (documentation only mention class file path directly, but it still produces the same error. And as seen using `class_name` works fine), so the error is misleading and should not appear.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create project
2. Create `entities.gd `
```
class_name Entities

class Player extends Node:
	var hp: int = 10
```
3. Create `player.gd`
```
extends Entities.Player

func _ready() -> void:
	print('I am indeed a Player, and I have HP that is: %s' % hp)
```
4. Attach `player.gd` to any Node in a Scene
5. Select this node in Scene
6. Error appear in Output (also appear on scene reload)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[inner_class_inherit_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31737303/inner_class_inherit_bug.zip)
